plates.side_label: 1752–1926 TIMELINE · RÉAUMUR & SPALLANZANI, CLAUDE BERNARD GLYCOGEN & MILIEU INTÉRIEUR, PAVLOV VAGAL REFLEXES & CANNON HOMEOSTASIS
plates.quality_reason: Flow-first: a teach diagram, chart, counter or timeline is a £0 code graphic. No Flow mint.
plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 3-era timeline completes: 1752 & 1780 (René-Antoine de Réaumur feeds perforated metal tubes of meat to his pet buzzard and Lazzaro Spallanzani swallows linen pouches to prove gastric digestion is chemical) · 1848 – 24 Mar 1857 & 1926 (Claude Bernard discovers pancreatic fat digestion, isolates hepatic glycogen from a washed liver, and formulates the milieu intérieur, named homeostasis by Walter Cannon in 1926) · 1897–1904 (Ivan Pavlov uses gastric pouches and sham feeding in St Petersburg to prove cephalic vagus-nerve digestive reflexes, winning the 1904 Nobel Prize).

teach_overlay.label: 1752–1926 DIGESTION, LIVER GLYCOGEN & HOMEOSTASIS TIMELINE · RÉAUMUR, SPALLANZANI, BERNARD, PAVLOV & CANNON
teach_overlay.detail: Animated timeline (1752 → 1926) alongside an inked summary of chemical gastric digestion, pancreatic lipolysis, hepatic glycogen buffering, and cephalic vagal control
teach_overlay.scale: from an iron tube coughed up by a pet buzzard to a washed liver on a Paris bench and a dog's dinner bowl in St Petersburg, scientists unlocked the chemical refinery that fuels every cell in your body
